jobs.title: Versioned Protocol Foundation
jobs.goal: Define v5 schemas for dispatch, attempts, raw responses, artifacts, completion claims, and condition results. Add schema tests for required fields, strict additional-property rejection, digest formats, unique attempt IDs, condition IDs, condition statuses, and side-effect classifications. Add explicit version loading that recognizes v4 as legacy_unattested. Add tests proving new runs use v5 while v4 runs remain available. Extend atomic persistence for immutable dispatch records, append-only attempts, raw responses, artifact records, claims, and condition results.
completion_conditions: All v5 schemas defined in schemas/v5/ with tests passing
v4 recognized as legacy_unattested in require_run_version
New runs use v5 by default
Atomic persistence extended for new record types

jobs.title: Transport Adapter And Dispatch Provenance
jobs.goal: Define the transport adapter capability handshake and receipt-verification interface. Implement a deterministic fake adapter with launch, resume, response, cancellation, loss, transcript-status, and receipt-verification controls. Persist a pending immutable dispatch before launch and return dispatch ID, canonical prompt path, prompt SHA-256, run/job correlation, and adapter requirement from next. Replace caller-authored session ingestion with launch-receipt ingestion. Add tests for genuine receipt acceptance, fabricated session rejection, wrong correlation, altered prompt delivery, duplicate receipt idempotence, and conflicting receipt rejection. Add crash-reconciliation tests.
completion_conditions: Fake adapter with full lifecycle controls implemented
Launch receipt ingestion replaces session strings

jobs.title: Attempts Responses And Recovery
jobs.goal: Replace singular session state with append-only attempts and active-attempt reference. Implement adapter-verified raw response ingestion storing exact response bytes and digest. Bind accepted outcomes to raw response, attempt, dispatch, and native session. Implement same-session format-repair for malformed live responses and response-retrieval for empty responses. Route canceled, lost, unavailable, contradictory results to recovery. Require every job definition to declare a side-effect class. Extend audit and recovery to classify pending dispatches and attempts. Add tests for malformed and empty responses, root-authored outcome rejection, cancellation recovery, ambiguous evidence, contradictory evidence, replacement-attempt history, and interrupted non-idempotent effects.
completion_conditions: Raw response ingestion with immutable storage

jobs.title: Run-Scoped Artifact Integrity
jobs.goal: Implement canonical run:// artifact reference parsing and safe resolution to run-owned absolute paths. Update prompts to provide canonical artifact references plus absolute paths. Extend normalized worker responses with artifact references and SHA-256 digests. Reject missing, changed, stale, prior-attempt, wrong-job, and cross-run report claims. Automatically include accepted dependency reports in dependent prompts in deterministic order. Preserve distinct labels and deduplicate canonical identities. Add tests for cross-run isolation, repeated job IDs, stale report reuse, root replacement, missing dependency reports, multi-dependency ordering, and advisory/dependency coexistence.
completion_conditions: Canonical run:// artifact references parsed and resolved
Worker-bound artifact provenance with SHA-256 digests
Dependency reports auto-propagated in deterministic order

jobs.title: Evidence-Gated Completion
jobs.goal: Replace string completion conditions with stable structured conditions containing ID, description, required flag, evidence requirement, verification mode, and designated verifier. Validate condition uniqueness, verifier existence, and dependency cycles during registration. Parse worker and verifier condition results using only passed, failed, not_run, unavailable, and unknown. Implement completion_claimed state and accept completion only when all required conditions pass. Schedule designated verifier jobs from target claims. Return run_complete with explicit run_status and successful. Add tests for omitted conditions, missing evidence, unauthorized self-approval, verifier pass, verifier defect, unavailable browser evidence, repair flow, successful terminal run, failed terminal run, and canceled terminal run.
completion_conditions: Structured completion conditions with stable IDs
Terminal run_complete with run_status and successful boolean

jobs.title: Root And Worker Instructions
jobs.goal: Rewrite SKILL.md with closed root allowlist, exact adapter dispatch loop, semantic-artifact prohibition, invalid-response flow, interruption recovery trigger, wait-reason handling, and terminal disposition rules. Update protocol.md, job-protocol.md, transport-capabilities.md, recovery.md, and maintainer guidance to match v5 semantics.
completion_conditions: SKILL.md rewritten with closed root allowlist
All reference docs updated for v5 semantics

jobs.title: Completion Prompt And Conformance Verification
jobs.goal: Rewrite AUTONOMOUS_COMPLETION_PROMPT.md to use resolved skill script path and available interpreter invocation. Document exact command syntax. Add parser-backed documentation tests for executable CLI examples. Run end-to-end fake-adapter orchestration covering implementation claim, dependency report delivery, independent verification, evidence acceptance, and successful run_complete. Run end-to-end interruption scenario covering canceled transport, audit, recovery-authorized replacement, append-only attempts, failed required evidence, and unsuccessful terminal disposition.
